findings: Dark-red structural role collapse: R14 hall paints red #8c3a22 and redlight #934329 on most beams, bracket arms and underside; wood #59301f is also very dark. Reference separates dark brown members, warmer exposed timber faces, vermilion verticals and limited gilt.

Surface chain is already a normalized grain CanvasTexture followed by white material baseColor. No material AO texture exists on timber; the held camera contact pass can multiply cavities down to 0.622 but cannot explain a whole-hall red hue. R15 therefore changes real material roles rather than camera exposure/AO or scene-wide lighting.

Window grid was mainly 28mm coplanar strips; eave rafters and two thin segmented fascia lines do not convey the reference nested timber thickness. R15 reconstructs thicker crossing muntins, recessed backing, larger rafter/tail solids and three actual continuous fascia courses.
